faq.q: What does the name Aamena mean?

faq.a: Aamena is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aamena a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aamena is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aamena written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aamena is written آمنة in Arabic and آمنہ in Urdu, and आमिना in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aamena?
faq.a: The root of Aamena is أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aamena?
faq.a: Feminine of Arabic amīn, 'trustworthy', from the root ʾ-m-n.

faq.q: Does Aamena appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; Āminah, 'trustworthy', is from the root ʾ-m-n.
Āminah bint Wahb was the mother of the Prophet Muhammad; her name means 'trustworthy, faithful' and is widely used in the Muslim world.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aamena?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aamena total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aamena?
faq.a: Aamena appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Amina, Aaminah.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aamena?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aamena include Aameen, Aamal.
It is the feminine of amīn, meaning 'trustworthy, faithful, secure'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aamena used today?
faq.a: Aamena is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
